title: Registering date tools on a Pydantic AI agent
description: This script registers get_today and days_until with @agent.tool_plain and runs the agent with a four-request limit.

steps.description: Create an Agent using make_model(), instructions telling the model to use tools for dates rather than guessing, and deterministic model settings.
@agent.tool_plain registers get_today and days_until as tools. Pydantic AI builds each tool's schema from its type hints and docstring.
agent.run_sync runs the prompt with UsageLimits(request_limit=4), then prints the final answer, the full message trace, and token and request usage.
